=== HYPOTHESIS ===
# p_91f4 — Elena works from home on Wednesdays; the office room is her backup

Elena's office allows one WFH day per week: Wednesday. On Wednesdays she works from the bedroom desk (desk_b1) with laptop_elena from 9:00 to 17:30, and her keys, wallet, jacket, sunglasses, shoes, and backpack stay at the entry. On all other weekdays she commutes as usual. Ines works from the office room (desk_o1) every weekday 9–17:30. This means on Wednesday mornings the entry area is fully stocked (both sets of keys, wallets, jackets present) while on other weekday mornings Elena's items are gone. The rest of the routine is standard: shared dinner, evening TV, weekend errands.

What sets this apart: On Wednesday, keys_elena, wallet_elena, jacket_elena, sunglasses_elena, shoes_elena, and backpack_elena are all at the entry (not OUT_OF_HOUSE), while laptop_elena is at desk_b1. On other weekdays those items are OUT_OF_HOUSE. What would refute it: keys_elena found OUT_OF_HOUSE on a Wednesday at 10:00, or laptop_elena found OUT_OF_HOUSE on a Wednesday.
